Raipur Railway Station Flooded During First Monsoon Rains

Raipur Railway Station experienced severe waterlogging during the initial monsoon showers, with water reportedly flowing like waterfalls onto platforms. The incident caused significant disruption and distress to passengers. Visuals of the flooding circulated widely, highlighting infrastructure issues.
